bio: I build agentic AI systems for enterprise customers. At Global Technology Solutions I have shipped 5+ multi-agent solutions with LangGraph and Google ADK, connected to company data and tools through MCP and the A2A protocol.
Before that I built RAG chatbots on AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, including a vector store on S3 that cut vector database costs by 90%.

On my own time I run experiments and publish the results: local versus cloud RAG, agent evaluation, drift detection, and forecasting with honest uncertainty. The projects below are the strongest of them.
